items.title: Amcor (AMCR) Tests Its Valuation After Higher Dividend And Lower EPS Outlook
items.summary: Amcor (NYSE:AMCR) just delivered a mixed update that combines higher quarterly sales and an increased dividend with a reduced adjusted EPS outlook, as rising energy and distribution costs pressure near term profitability. Investors are reacting quickly to the mixed update from Amcor, with the share price falling 5.48% on the day to US$45.84, even though the 30 day share price return of 9.74% and year to date gain of 9.01% point to improving short term momentum.
